comparator.name: Philosophy
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 catalogue specifies 180 EC for the regular full-time Philosophy degree. The third year includes 42 EC free choice, a 6 EC specialisation course linked to the thesis group and the 12 EC thesis.

components.name: Philosophy elective
components.note: Choose an approved philosophy elective or an additional specialisation course.

components.name: Free-choice electives
components.note: Up to 12 EC may come from first-year courses. Choices may include a minor, internship or study abroad.

components.name: Thesis specialisation course
components.note: Take the course linked to the chosen thesis group before starting the thesis.

components.name: Bachelor’s Thesis in Philosophy
components.note: Complete year one, Text, Context and Debate and 12 EC of specialisation courses. Take the linked thesis specialisation course.
